project_info.theme: Alternative fisheye rooftop streetwear portrait with a huge foreground sneaker
project_info.creative_direction: Dynamic urban fashion image built around extreme foreshortening, modern towers, and athletic red-and-white styling
project_info.color_palette: bright red, white, black, blue sky, reflective steel, and pale concrete

main_subject.detail: adult woman with shoulder-length brown hair, direct relaxed gaze, and confident urban-explorer attitude
main_subject.wardrobe: bright red track jacket with white sleeve stripes, black-to-red fitted leggings, and oversized white chunky sneakers with red tread
main_subject.action: seated on a modern ledge with one shoe thrust toward the camera

composition_elements.framing: vertical low-angle full-body crop with the shoe sole filling the lower foreground
composition_elements.environment: high urban rooftop or architectural platform surrounded by curved glass towers
composition_elements.perspective: 8mm-to-12mm fisheye distortion and forced perspective, sharp sneaker foreground and skyline background
composition_elements.background: bright open sky, modern building surfaces, clean ledge, and no crowd

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: bright direct daylight at approximately 5600K with natural reflected fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: sunburst lens flare at upper left, crisp high-contrast shadows, vivid red accents, and realistic sneaker leather texture

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with 10mm fisheye lens, extreme worm's-eye fashion photography
technical_specs.finish: deep depth of field, slight barrel distortion, natural vignetting, realistic modern materials, and controlled color

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a dynamic urban streetwear fashion photograph of a clearly adult woman with shoulder-length brown hair seated casually on a modern rooftop ledge, looking down toward the camera with a confident, relaxed expression. One leg and an oversized white chunky sneaker with a bold red tread extend dramatically toward the lens and fill the foreground. She wears a bright red track jacket with white stripes on the sleeves and fitted red-and-black leggings. Frame her with curved glass skyscrapers and sleek modern architecture from an extreme worm's-eye view. Use an approximately 10mm fisheye lens, bright 5600K daylight, a sunburst lens flare in the upper left, crisp high-contrast shadows, deep depth of field, realistic leather and concrete texture, slight barrel distortion, and vivid controlled color.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, unsafe ledge, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, broken shoe anatomy, distorted buildings
